decisions.rules_followed: R3 and promotion rule v3 for selection quality, Arena, anchor, tactical and time gates

limits.wall_clock_start: the start of the first desktop run under this delegation (recorded in the state file)
limits.note: the 24 hours are the delegation limit, not a duration estimate

retry: only for an infrastructure error independent of any reading, after its cause is identified, once; the failure record is kept
stop: a contract criterion not met (the result is kept and the delegation ends)
HOLD, NOT_ESTABLISHED or any label that does not open the next phase
SHA, model-link or comparability error (reported, no retry)
the wall-clock or run limits reached
never: relax a criterion after seeing a result
repeat a run for a better result
edit a frozen file or an earlier record
change the champion, canonical, the web SER5 or V9

execution.cloud_session: code, contracts, tests, approval commits, record analysis
execution.desktop: GPU and Rapfi runs (~/renju-h6), long jobs under tmux, HEAD fixed during a run, commits only between steps

report: short notes on each completion, failure or important finding; at the end, in Korean: results, grounds, commit SHAs, remaining uncertainty, the R4 resumption proposal or the reason for stopping
